activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [145].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [145] 的字詞或句子。

options.text: The finance team no longer accepts expense reports.
options.zh: 財務團隊不再受理報銷單。
options.whyZh: 整篇是在要求按期限提交報告，並未停止受理。

options.text: A card statement may help support the explanation, but it does not guarantee approval.
options.zh: 刷卡交易明細可協助佐證這筆費用的說明，但不保證核准。
options.whyZh: 延續收據遺失後須補資料、且不自動核准的說明。

options.text: Every expense without a receipt will be paid automatically.
options.zh: 沒有收據的費用一律自動給付。
options.whyZh: 與前文明說不自動核准矛盾。

options.text: There is no need to explain the expense if a receipt is missing.
options.zh: 若收據遺失，就不必說明該筆費用。
options.whyZh: 前文明確說收據遺失時要填寫表單並說明該筆費用。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 延續收據遺失後須補資料、且不自動核准的說明。
activeQuestion.evidence: Approval is not automatic; the finance team may request additional information.

vocabulary.note: 組織償付員工先代墊的核准費用。

group.title: Travel reimbursement reminder
group.passage:
To all travelling staff,

Please submit your expense report within ten days of returning from a business trip. Each claim must be [143] ____ by a receipt that shows the date, amount, and business name.

If a receipt is missing, complete the missing-receipt form and explain the expense. Approval is not automatic; the finance team may request [144] ____ information. [145] ____

To avoid delays, check that the total on your report matches the attached documents. Claims with missing details will be returned for correction rather than [146] ____ immediately.
group.passageZh:
各位出差同仁：

請在出差返回後十天內提交差旅費報銷單。每筆申請都必須以一張列有日期、金額及商家名稱的收據來 [143] ____。

若收據遺失，請填寫收據遺失表並說明費用。申請不會自動核准；財務團隊可能要求 [144] ____ 資訊。[145] ____

為避免延誤，請確認報銷單總額與附件相符。資料不全的報銷申請會退回更正，不會立即 [146] ____。
